تحترفن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَرِفْنَ (taḥtarifna) /taħ.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# تُحْتَرَفْنَ (tuḥtarafna) /tuħ.ta.raf.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
